questions.solution_html:
• 11 Draw the block diagram of a PC and give its working (5 Marks)
  • Block Diagram (2 Mark):Components: Input devices, Output devices, CPU (ALU, CU, Registers), Memory(Primary and Secondary), Motherboard, PSU.
  • Explanation of Working (3 Marks)
  • ● Input: Devices send data to CPU.
  • ● Processing: CPU performs operations with data stored in RAM.
  • ● Output: Processed data is sent to output devices.
  • ● Storage: Data is saved to HDD/SSD.
  • ● Power: PSU supplies stable power to components.
  • Reference Text:Upgrading and repairing of PC’s- Scott Mueller’s
  • 12 Explain how the voltage regulator, BIOS ROM, CMOS battery, and RAM work together to ensure the
  • smooth operation of a computer (5 Marks)
  • ● Voltage Regulator (1 Mark): Stabilizes voltage levels for critical components.
  • ● BIOS ROM (1 Mark): Contains firmware to perform POST (Power-On Self-Test) and load the OS.
  • ● CMOS Battery (1 Mark): Powers CMOS to retain system time and BIOS settings.
  • ● RAM (2 Marks): Temporarily stores data for the CPU during operation to enable multitasking.
  • Reference Text: Upgrading and repairing of PC’s- Scott Mueller’s
  • 13 What is the purpose of the RF unit on a smartphone motherboard? (5 Marks)
  • RF Unit Purpose
  • ● Enables wireless communication (2 Marks): Facilitates cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and GPSsignals.
  • ● Signal Conversion (3 Marks): Converts analog RF signals to digital and vice versa for processing.
  • Reference Text: Smartphone troubleshooting & repair
  • 14 Name three common types of connectors found on the back panel of a motherboard (5 Marks)
  • Common Types -any 3(5 marks), any 2(3 marks), any 1(1.5 marks)
  • ● USB (Universal Serial Bus) Ports: For peripheral connectivity.
  • ● HDMI (High-Definition Multimedia Interface): For video and audio output.
  • ● Ethernet Port: For network connectivity.
  • Reference Text: PC hardware maintanence & trouble shooting-N S Reddy
  • 15 Compare the functions of the accelerometer and gyroscope in a smartphone (5 Marks)
  • ● Accelerometer (2.5 Marks):Measures linear acceleration of the device.Detects orientationchanges
  • ● Gyroscope (2.5 Marks):Measures angular velocity.Provides precision in tracking rotation
  • Reference Text: Smartphone troubleshooting & repair.
  • 16 Describe how GPS (Global Positioning System) functions in a smartphone (5 Marks)
  • ● Satellite Communication (3 Marks): GPS uses signals from satellites to determine location.
  • ● Output (2 Mark): Location data is used in navigation apps.
  • Reference Text: Smartphone troubleshooting & repair

questions.question: Explain the purpose of POST and its role in diagnosing hardware failure. A 2
questions.solution_html:
• 11 Draw the block diagram of a PC and give its working (5 Marks)
  • Block Diagram (2 Mark):Components: Input devices, Output devices, CPU (ALU, CU, Registers), Memory(Primary and Secondary), Motherboard, PSU.
  • Explanation of Working (3 Marks)
  • ● Input: Devices send data to CPU.
  • ● Processing: CPU performs operations with data stored in RAM.
  • ● Output: Processed data is sent to output devices.
  • ● Storage: Data is saved to HDD/SSD.
  • ● Power: PSU supplies stable power to components.
  • Reference Text:Upgrading and repairing of PC’s- Scott Mueller’s
  • 12 Explain how the voltage regulator, BIOS ROM, CMOS battery, and RAM work together to ensure the
  • smooth operation of a computer (5 Marks)
  • ● Voltage Regulator (1 Mark): Stabilizes voltage levels for critical components.
  • ● BIOS ROM (1 Mark): Contains firmware to perform POST (Power-On Self-Test) and load the OS.
  • ● CMOS Battery (1 Mark): Powers CMOS to retain system time and BIOS settings.
  • ● RAM (2 Marks): Temporarily stores data for the CPU during operation to enable multitasking.
  • Reference Text: Upgrading and repairing of PC’s- Scott Mueller’s
  • 13 What is the purpose of the RF unit on a smartphone motherboard? (5 Marks)
  • RF Unit Purpose
  • ● Enables wireless communication (2 Marks): Facilitates cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and GPSsignals.
  • ● Signal Conversion (3 Marks): Converts analog RF signals to digital and vice versa for processing.
  • Reference Text: Smartphone troubleshooting & repair
  • 14 Name three common types of connectors found on the back panel of a motherboard (5 Marks)
  • Common Types -any 3(5 marks), any 2(3 marks), any 1(1.5 marks)
  • ● USB (Universal Serial Bus) Ports: For peripheral connectivity.
  • ● HDMI (High-Definition Multimedia Interface): For video and audio output.
  • ● Ethernet Port: For network connectivity.
  • Reference Text: PC hardware maintanence & trouble shooting-N S Reddy
  • 15 Compare the functions of the accelerometer and gyroscope in a smartphone (5 Marks)
  • ● Accelerometer (2.5 Marks):Measures linear acceleration of the device.Detects orientationchanges
  • ● Gyroscope (2.5 Marks):Measures angular velocity.Provides precision in tracking rotation
  • Reference Text: Smartphone troubleshooting & repair.
  • 16 Describe how GPS (Global Positioning System) functions in a smartphone (5 Marks)
  • ● Satellite Communication (3 Marks): GPS uses signals from satellites to determine location.
  • ● Output (2 Mark): Location data is used in navigation apps.
  • Reference Text: Smartphone troubleshooting & repair
